text: **Hint 1:** Identify the values of the variables in the equation for a blue collar worker with $$10$$ years of education. Remember that for a blue collar worker, $x_{b} $$=$$ 1$ and $x_{m} $$=$$ 0$.\n\n**Hint 2:** Substitute the values of $x_{edu}$, $x_{m}$, and $x_{b}$ into the equation $\hat{y} $$=$$ $$-8$$ + 3x_{edu} + 6x_{m} - 3x_{b}$ to calculate the predicted wage.
